Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National | Top Story Hotline Documentary Video: Inside The Dreaded Headmaster’s Bungalow Source : Myjoyonline 19 October 2026 7:36am Audio By Carbonatix
JoyNews’ investigative documentary, “HOTLINE: Inside the Dreaded Headmaster’s Bungalow,” takes a closer look at allegations of sexual abuse involving the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School, who has since been interdicted by the Ghana Education Service following the report.
The documentary, produced following an investigation by JoyNews Investigative Correspondent Manasseh Azure Awuni, examines the disturbing allegations and the issues uncovered by the investigation.
